breadcrumb.label: Broadcast Announcers And Radio Disc Jockeys

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career combines an outgoing personality, quick reactions, and digital audience awareness. Programs must be entertaining and dependable, while hosts must retain and grow their audiences.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career develops vocal delivery and live performance. Announcers need a strong voice, clear communication, quick improvisation, and control of the on-air atmosphere. It suits outgoing, quick-thinking people who are willing to train their voices and build digital audience awareness.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: A preference for creativity, expression, and practical results (Artistic A + Enterprising E + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「外向 + 反应快 + 有网感」凑一块的人——节目要好玩也要稳，听众要留也要涨。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「嘴 + 临场」——既要声音条件和表达力，也要会即兴接话、会控场氛围。适合外向、反应快、也愿意练嗓子和网感的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好创造、表达、也务实（艺术 A + 企业 E + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits practical people who know what they are doing. A vehicle arrives with a shattered windshield and leaves with clean, intact glass, offering an immediate sense of accomplishment that many office jobs cannot provide.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The satisfaction in this work is immediate: a vehicle arrives with a shattered windshield and leaves with clean, intact glass. If you are good with your hands, enjoy tools and vehicles, and do not mind detailed tasks, you can appreciate the tangible feeling of completing one job at a time.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Enterprising (E)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「手上有活、心里有数」的人——车进来时前挡碎着，开出去时干干净净，这种立竿见影的成就感，是很多办公室工作给不了的。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的成就感在「立竿见影」：一辆车进来的时候前挡碎着，开出去的时候干干净净。你动手能力强、喜欢跟工具和车打交道、又不嫌活细碎，会在这里找到「干完一个是一个」的实在感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people with steady hands, attention to detail, and patience. When your coil passes insulation tests and a motor runs reliably for ten years, the work provides tangible satisfaction.
riasec_fit_block.interest: Precision creates the value in this work. Orderly wire placement and complete insulation let a motor run reliably for ten years. People who enjoy detailed work, sustain focus, and keep learning can find satisfaction in visible craftsmanship.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Investigative (I)

breadcrumb.label: 线圈绕线工、包扎工、修整工

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「手稳、心细、坐得住」的人——你绕的线圈绝缘合格、电机稳定转十年，就是最大的踏实感。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在「精密」：线圈排线整齐、绝缘包扎到位，电机才能稳定转上十年。喜欢细致活、坐得住、又愿意学的人，会在这里找到「手底下见真章」的踏实感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 研究型 I

breadcrumb.label: Control And Valve Installers And Repairers, Except Mechanical Door

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career turns craftsmanship into reliability. After you repair and accurately calibrate a difficult valve, the whole line runs steadily again. Few rewards feel more concrete than knowing the plant depends on your work.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The reassuring part of this work is that a small valve carries major responsibility. A sticking control valve can stop an entire production line or cause an incident. Repairing and calibrating a stubborn valve until process readings return to normal brings a tangible sense that your skill keeps the plant running.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C

breadcrumb.label: 控制与阀门安装维修工（非机械门类）

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最让人安心的是「手艺换可靠」：一台让你头疼的阀门，修好、调准之后，整条线恢复平稳运行，那种被工厂需要的感觉，比什么都实在。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最让人踏实的是「阀门虽小，责任很大」：一个卡涩的调节阀，可能让整条生产线停摆甚至出事故。你把一台「不服管」的阀门修到听话，看着工艺参数恢复正常，那种「这厂子能转起来有我一份」的感觉很实在。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 研究型 I + 常规型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who can investigate deeply and then step back to see the whole. They move between archival detail and the wider narrative.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The compelling part of this work is giving silent objects a voice. Research and display can make a visitor spend ten minutes with an unremarkable old object. Turning an exhibition from an idea into reality creates tangible satisfaction.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Artistic A + Investigative I + Enterprising E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「能钻进去、又能跳出来」的人——钻得进故纸堆，跳得出来看大局。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最迷人的地方在于「让沉默的东西说话」：一件不起眼的旧物件，经过你的考据和布展，能让观众停下来看十分钟。把一个展览从想法变成现实，那种成就感很实在。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 艺术型 A + 研究型 I + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine route knowledge, stamina, and customer skills. They drive safely, deliver every item, and maintain customer trust.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field depends on route knowledge, stamina, and customer skills. Drivers know the territory, handle lifting, communicate with customers, and collect payments. It suits people who prefer fieldwork over desk work and enjoy working with others.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical, hands-on work and enjoys field sales (Realistic R + Enterprising E + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「认路 + 皮实 + 会来事儿」凑一块的人——车要开稳、货要送到、客户要哄好。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最吃「认路 + 皮实 + 会来事儿」。路线要熟、搬运要扛、遇到客户还要会聊会收账。适合不爱坐班、能跑外勤、又愿意跟人打交道的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好动手实干、也愿意跑外勤做生意（现实 R + 企业 E + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This occupation suits people willing to devote themselves to a school. They manage more than teachers and students; they hold the trust of hundreds of families.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The satisfaction in this work comes from seeing an entire school improve. A stable teaching staff, higher instructional quality, and stronger parent trust create a sense of system-wide progress. The role suits people who want to lead, tolerate pressure, and accept responsibility for a team.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising E + Social S + Artistic A

breadcrumb.label: 幼儿园至中学教育行政管理者

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「愿意为一所学校操碎心」的人——你管的不只是老师学生，是几百个家庭的信任。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的成就感在「看见整所学校变好」——师资稳了、教学质量上去了、家长信任了，这种系统性的成长感很宏大。适合有管理欲、扛得住压力、愿意为团队兜底的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 企业型 E + 社会型 S + 艺术型 A

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This role suits people who enjoy making complex ideas simple and care about student development.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most rewarding part of this work is influencing people. A student who once thought programming was impossible can understand after a clear explanation. Former graduate students can later join leading companies or universities. That achievement can matter more than another paper.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Artistic A + Social S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「既享受把复杂讲简单，又愿意为学生的成长操心」的人。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有意思的地方是「影响人」：一个原本觉得自己学不会编程的学生，因为你讲透了某个概念而开窍；带过的研究生后来进了大厂、去了海外名校，这种成就感是论文都替代不了的。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 艺术型 A + 社会型 S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who like staying active. Rush periods leave no idle time, and seeing prepared ingredients become plated dishes provides immediate satisfaction.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The rhythm of this work comes from intense rush periods. Lunch service can leave no free minute, but seeing your prepared ingredients become a finished dish creates a direct sense of accomplishment. People who tolerate standing, work quickly, and enjoy a busy kitchen can find their own rhythm.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Enterprising E + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「手脚停不下来」的人——忙起来一秒钟都不闲着，看着自己备的料变成菜端出去，就是最直接的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的节奏感在于「忙起来是真的忙」：午市高峰一分钟都停不下来，但看到自己备的料变成一道菜端出去，又很有成就感。你不怕站、手脚麻利、又愿意在后厨的烟火气里干活，会找到属于自己的节奏。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 企业型 E + 事务型 C

breadcrumb.label: Elementary School Teachers, Except Special Education

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career fits people who combine patience, communication, and responsibility. Teachers must explain knowledge clearly, respond to children's pace, and balance classroom management with care.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops creativity grounded in patience. Teachers must explain curriculum clearly while adapting to each child's pace. It suits people who enjoy children, can stay focused, and accept responsibility for growth.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers helping, practical, and creative work (Social S + Investigative I + Artistic A).

breadcrumb.label: 小学教师（不含特殊教育）

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「耐心 + 表达 + 责任感」凑一块的人——知识点要讲清也要接住孩子节奏，管理和爱心要平衡也要会聊。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「耐心里的创造力」——既要按大纲把知识点讲透，也要把每个孩子不同的节奏接住。适合喜欢孩子、坐得住、也愿意为成长负责的性子。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好助人、务实、也创造（社会 S + 务实 I + 艺术 A）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: O*NET assigns Marketing Managers the EC interest code: Enterprising and Conventional. Enterprising E is the foundation because the work depends on persuasion, organization, and resource integration over time. Conventional C supports processes and budgets. If your E is very low, that does not necessarily...
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most tangible satisfaction comes when a campaign you designed actually drives growth. Watching the performance curve rise is more direct than any presentation.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising E + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: O*NET 给 Marketing Managers 的兴趣代码是 EC：企业型、常规型。企业型 E 是底座（长期依赖说服、组织与资源整合）；常规型 C 负责流程与预算。如果你的 E 很低，不一定不
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最实在的满足感来自「一条自己定的campaign真的带来了增长」——看着投放曲线翘起来，比任何汇报都直观。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 企业型 E + 常规型 C

breadcrumb.label: Middle School Teachers, Except Special And Career/Technical Education

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who enjoy influencing another person. When a student looks back three years later and calls you their teacher, that is the greatest reward.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value of this work lies in shaping a person who is still developing. The student they become three years later reflects your contribution. People who enjoy communicating, have patience, and want to work with adolescents can find lasting fulfillment here.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social S + Artistic A + Enterprising E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合享受「影响一个人」的人——三年后学生回头喊你一声老师，就是最大的回报。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在「影响一个正在成型的人」——学生三年后的样子，有你的一份力。喜欢表达、有耐心、愿意和青春期孩子打交道的人，会在这里找到持续的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 社会型 S + 艺术型 A + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The thrill comes from letting data decide. One product decision or one campaign adjustment shows results several hours later. Wins and losses become understandable, creating the compelling control of being your own boss.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The excitement comes from fast feedback. A page changed last night affects today's conversion rate, and ads show results within several hours. Data-driven rapid experimentation suits people who like immediate feedback and control.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising E + Artistic A + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最过瘾的是「数据说了算」：一个选品决定、一次投放调整，几小时后就有结果反馈，赢要赢得明白，亏要亏得清楚，这种「自己当自己的老板」的掌控感很上头。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最刺激的是「反馈来得快」：昨晚改的详情页，今天转化率就变了；投的广告，几小时就看出效果。数据说话、快速试错，适合喜欢「即时反馈」和「自己说了算」的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 企业型 E + 艺术型 A + 常规型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine attention to detail + composure + a love of numbers. Figures must be accurate and clearly verified, requiring a balance of rules and systems with strong reconciliation skills.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops persistence with numbers. You must understand rules, calculate accurately, and have the care to trace anomalies to their source. It suits meticulous people who can remain focused, accept responsibility for numbers, and enjoy moving from disorder to balanced accounts.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers routine, practical work, and helping others (Conventional C + Realistic E + Social R).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细致 + 稳重 + 爱数字」凑一块的人——数要准也要查得清，规则和系统要平衡也要会对。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「数里的较真」——既要懂规则算得准，也要有把异常查到底的细心。适合细致、坐得住、也愿意对数字负责的人，也享受从杂乱到平账的过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好常规、务实、也助人（常规 C + 务实 E + 社会 R）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you enjoy the certainty of serving as a gatekeeper, where every decision has a basis and every checkpoint protects safety, this career provides stable and tangible positive feedback.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value of this career lies in responsibility and stability. Transportation safety is essential, and railroads, ports, and freight forwarders consistently need inspectors whose experience becomes more valuable over time. The work also provides broad industry exposure to frontline terminals and bulk logistics.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Realistic R + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你喜欢「把关」带来的确定性——每个判定都有依据、每道关卡都守住安全，这行会给你稳定而踏实的正反馈。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在于「责任与稳定」：运输安全是刚需，铁路、港口、货代常年要人，经验越足越吃香；同时能接触到港口码头、大宗物流的一线现场，行业视野比较宽。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 现实型 R + 常规型 C
